checks.evidence: R2 defines missing-parent, missing-leaf and present first-observation states; read-only commands retain every acquired ancestor plus the exact first missing edge without creating directories. It requires absence on every exit and disallows claiming descendants below a missing parent.

Build creation is separated from read-only inspection: existing batch-session creation is allowed only for build, source-catalog uses exclusive mkdir, absent catalog uses exclusive no-clobber installation, foreign post-observation appearance refuses even with identical bytes, and owned install identity/mode/bytes are re-bound after temp cleanup.

The dedicated source-catalog directory is constrained to catalog.json or empty, its complete set is retained/rechecked, temporary installer material is not a persistent sibling, and surrounding .work/batch sibling namespaces are not accidentally claimed.

R2 applies final safety verification across Vault, generation and cache groups together, continuing after ordinary parser/limit failures. Foreign edges, parent/leaf races and generation changes therefore retain WORK_PATH_UNSAFE precedence.

R2 requires complete recursive .py name sets, complete schema-resource registry sets, traversed directory identities, retained ancestors and exact bytes, then final re-enumeration. Added/removed siblings, ancestor replacement and file identity/byte changes refuse; normal __pycache__/.pyc activity is explicitly outside the declared set.

R2 fixes profile_sha256 as SHA-256 of the exact raw UTF-8 catalog/source-catalog-v1.json bytes, including whitespace, while the profile itself has no expected self-hash. The frozen initial profile bytes and digest are supplied externally and the profile resource is already in the 17-path production allowlist.

R1 authority remains intact: one retained Vault session, require_rendered=True, complete compiled pages/head registries and full snapshot_material inventory; R2 adds equivalent retained lineage for generation inputs and requires final verification across all groups.

prior_findings.closure: The explicit first-observation state machine and exclusive build/adopt rules close missing-parent/leaf handling and foreign post-absence ambiguity.
Scoped complete .py/schema sets plus ancestor identities and exact bytes are captured and re-enumerated; pycache activity is explicitly excluded.
Raw profile resource bytes, digest formula, fixed domain and no-self-hash rule are explicit; initial bytes are bound by the supplied exact profile SHA.
